steps.text: Chaval.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Teach? What's going on?

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Javier led the Inquisition to us. Señora Juana is being held captive in the captain's quarters.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Why did you come back?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I don't know... Same reason as you, probably.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Wait... is that one of your friends hiding on the opposite deck?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Huh? Is that Isidro? I guess he really did come back.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: See, I told you. I mean, even I couldn't stay away.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Of course he'd come back when he saw the fire. He's my best amigo, after all!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: What about me?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Why did I have to come too?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Um, to help put out the fire?

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Wake up, señora!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Perlita... Where's Nene? You shouldn't have come back.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: I set it free in the Flat. It may be weak, but better out there than getting killed by mutineers.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: We can't just leave you here.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: You don't look well...

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: What did they do to you?!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Nothing... just gave me some drugs.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: You could have fled. You would have lived.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I didn't take you for someone who would give up so easily.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Now that we're all here, don't we have better things to do than just talk? You know the Salt Flat better than anyone else, señora. Is there anywhere we can go?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: How big is our group?

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Twenty-four.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Excelente. Enough to commandeer a ship.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Which one?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: La Conquista.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: That's the oldest one, slower than the newer salt ships.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: But I know it best.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Besides, because they consider it an antique, it will be lightly guarded. All the easier for us.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: I'll take eight men up to the deck and get rid of the sentries. The others will go in through the side with Elysium and deal with the rest.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: What about me?

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Stay with Señora Juana. She's... not at her best, and won't be able to move as quickly.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Alert Sailor
steps.text: What's that noise?

steps.name: Alert Sailor
steps.text: Argh—

steps.name: Patrolling Sailor
steps.text: Ngh—

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: My aching bones... Maybe I'm getting too old for this.

steps.name: Trustworthy Sailor
steps.text: The guys on the deck are out cold. I tossed 'em overboard.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Good. Climb the mast and be ready to hoist the sail at my command. We'll need full speed on the double.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: You done over there?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We got the ones below deck.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: A hand, please.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Now we wait for the boss.

steps.name: Serious Warrior Priest
steps.text: Search inch by inch. By the Alguacil's orders, we must find the compass.

steps.name: Reliable Warrior Priest
steps.text: We've turned every room upside down, but haven't found anything remotely like it.

steps.name: Serious Warrior Priest
steps.text: Keep looking. Don't miss a single nook or corner.

steps.name: Reliable Warrior Priest
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Señores, the Alguacil has issued new orders. A squad is to come with me to pursue the fleeing alchemist.

steps.name: Serious Warrior Priest
steps.text: And why are you the one delivering the order?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: What's wrong with that? We're still working together according to our agreement.

steps.name: Reliable Warrior Priest
steps.text: Very well. Wait here while we muster the men.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Gracias.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: What is Javier doing over here?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: No idea, but he's gotten rid of the warrior priests for us, even if he didn't mean to.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: When they leave, we can continue behind those tents.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: They won't be able to see us from any of the salt ships.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I can see you've become an expert at sneaking through our base.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Ngh...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Hang on. We're almost there.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Go on to the deck first. I need to fetch something from the lab.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Be quick.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: A ship from the old era...

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Does your desire for the compass point towards the source of the calamity, the ocean?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Where did I leave it...

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: You.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...You.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: It is you who has been leading the raids.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: And it is you who has been repairing the compass.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: People always tell me to look for the good in others.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: The truth always proves them fools. When first we met, I knew you intended to take the compass for your own sinful alchemical research.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: I was right.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: The compass is no more. I'm still trying to scrape what's left of it off the transmutation table.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: That black mud? No, that is not the true compass. Your lies have no purchase here.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Must the Inquisition spill so much blood for each thing it loses?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: You know that the compass corrupts the heart.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: It's nothing more than a tool for sailing the seas.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Sailing the seas. Hah.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Those who attempt to elude both judgment and the reins of morality often seek out thorny paths that few have walked, and distant shores that none have reached.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: As if their accomplishments could offer sanctuary for their sins.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I don't recall sinning.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Harboring a thief, feeding upon the remains of the townsfolk, assaulting a cleric of the Inquisition, associating with bandits who menace the town... Is that not enough?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Pretexts and framed crimes.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: And now you begin to deny your sins.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: All who have sinned will desperately deny it. I was no exception.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: But I learned to accept my sins, and thus discovered the path of atonement.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: My life was born from the evils of cannibalism. My very being is a sin. I am unworthy of the liberation of death.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: But you were once pure and upright, before desire corrupted you. You have the right to die.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: I will free you.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: You're insane...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I don't have time for this!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Strange. Why isn't Isidro here?

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: It's all right. He must be somewhere on the ship, so everybody's accounted for.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Just waiting on your orders, señora.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Hoist the sails.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: We sail.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: This ship...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: (Mierda, Juana doesn't know this lunatic is in here!)

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: (He'll be nothing but trouble once the ship starts moving.)

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Everyone involved in this futile escape attempt is on this ship, correct?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Shut it.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: This is where it ends for all of you, along with this sinful vessel of the old era.
The Alguacil's attacks are ferocious. All Isidro can do is defend himself.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: (This is getting me nowhere... I have to do something...)
This is his own lab. There must be something he can do here.
What does he do best?
During the time he spent here, his most frequent creations were undoubtedly explosions of various sizes.
Explosions...
This calls for an explosion.
*cough* *cough* Argh! Ugh!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: ...Thorns?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Finally! You were starting to scare me when you went down to the lab and didn't come back.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I ran into someone from the Inquisition there.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I thought we cleaned out the cabins.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I don't know how he got there. He just came in all of a sudden looking for the compass, and wasn't in a mood to negotiate.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I had to blow up the lab to eject him from the ship.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Him and half of this ship!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: ...Good work.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Is there anything from the lab left, though?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...Maybe?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Very well...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: We're going into the Skeletal Reef. The ocean lies just beyond that.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: You might have one last chance to repair the compass before we arrive.

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: S-Señor Silver! The Alguacil is still on that ship! We must come to his aid!

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: No one could survive an explosion like that.

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: But the Alguacil...

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: I said, no.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Will we let his martyrdom go to waste, sacrificing the living for the sake of the departed?

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: But what if he's still—

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Aarón needs you now more than ever. Take inventory of the confiscated supplies, and round up the prisoners.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: This is an order.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Steady! You're gonna snap the mast in two!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Are you trying to crash the ship on those bones and have us hang on them to dry like human jerky?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Full left rudder!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: —Full left rudder!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Damage to the starboard side! Another hit from a steam blast, and this ship's going to fall apart!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: The skeleton formations are getting denser! We'll crash if we don't steer this just right!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: The erupting steam means we're close to the Skeletal Reef.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: They won't dare go in there!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: But do we? The steam blasts will punch through us like a hot knife through butter!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Better than the Inquisition, at least!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: ...Ugh!
Boiling steam shoots out of gaps in the skeletons and tears the sail apart with terrible force.
The gang is thrown into the air before crashing back onto the deck.
The helm wheel spins wildly out of control. Gushing steam sends the ship crashing towards a massive skeleton more than a dozen meters tall!
Juana says nothing, as if waiting for something.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Weedy! You're an engineer! Do something!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: This is my first time on a Golden Age ship, never mind one that's been modified beyond recognition! I need time to figure out how it works!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Do we abandon ship? We might survive if we jump right now!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Are you loco?! You'll be impaled by saltfins in less than a minute!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: —Señora!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We're done for...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: No, we're not.
Juana looks towards the spinning helm wheel.

If the ship were alive, its flesh would have been stripped away by a century of wear, leaving only a bare skeleton. Even its once-magnificent embroidered sail was replaced with a patchwork of finskin.
Yet, the helm stands proud at the deck's center.
Juana halts the spinning helm wheel with her hands, as if steadying a dance partner, and begins to turn it with a frenzied rhythm. Her ink-black hair whips around like seaweed caught in raging tides.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: It's been so long, old friend!
La Conquista brushes past the massive skeleton, banking at a dangerous angle. Only by hanging onto a rope for dear life did the passengers avoid being thrown overboard.
For decades, this heavy old ship has had to drift slowly behind other salt ships.
Now, though, it darts through the bones, riding upon the wind, as it once navigated treacherous reefs with Juana at the helm.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Señora...?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: W-We're on course again!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: I... I'm alive? Do I have all my body parts? Am I hanging off a piece of bone?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You said... YOU SAID YOU ONLY NEEDED ME TO PUT OUT A FIRE!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well, figuratively... right?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: What's the situation, Thorns? How much of the lab is left?
They stand in silence before the carnage.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I managed to salvage the transmutation table. The outer casing is gone, but the output's stable enough...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: As for the probes... this is the only one left. Pretty worn, but still usable.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: And we still have a little bit of alloy and Originium, scavenged from the antiques. I don't know if it's enough though...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Anything I can help with?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Are your fingers as thin as a probe needle?
A long rumble interrupts the conversation as Elysium places a hand on his belly, looking embarrassed.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: At this rate, they might be soon. We don't have much food on the ship...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...Let's go find some.
